steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Kimai at http://127.0.0.1:8105/en/login as admin@example.com using password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify that sign-in succeeded and report the resulting page.
02-find: In Kimai, find and report exactly the names of all projects whose name starts with 'Seed:'. Do not edit anything; verify the full names from the projects list.

03-create: Create and save exactly one new Kimai project named '{{runid}} Bench Project' with a description that includes the exact runid '{{runid}}'. Do not edit any seed project. Verify the saved project name and description; leave other project fields at defaults for now.

04-verify: Ensure the saved project '{{runid}} Bench Project' is assigned to the existing customer exactly '{{03-create.customer_used}}' (not a similarly named customer). Verify the customer on the saved project details page, and save only if a change is needed.

05-create: Create and save exactly one timesheet entry on project '{{runid}} Bench Project' for 2026-09-16 from 09:00 to 11:30, with a description including exact runid '{{runid}}'. Choose the existing activity exactly 'Consulting' and set its only tag to the existing tag exactly 'onsite' (do not create a tag or choose similar names). Verify the saved entry's project, date, times, description, activity, and only tag.

06-verify: Resolve and verify the order date for the existing project '{{runid}} Bench Project' (id shown by its details URL). In the project edit form, set the actual Order date field to 2026-11-15 and save; then reopen the edit form and verify the date field still reads 2026-11-15, as well as confirming order number PO-4471. If the value will not persist, report exactly what the form shows and do not claim success.
